headline: A 2010 executive order sets the line of officials who would lead the Department of Agriculture if top leaders cannot serve.
what_it_does: This order lists which officials would step in to act as Secretary of Agriculture if the Secretary and other top leaders die, resign, or cannot do the job. The goal is that someone is clearly in charge so the department can keep working. Only the title was available, so the exact list of officials is not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Senior officials at the Department of Agriculture
who_it_affects.how: Some officials are named in an order of who would temporarily take over the Secretary's duties if needed.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed May 13, 2010; the available information does not state a separate start date.
